functions.name: WithServiceBus
functions.description: Adds a Service Bus child resource to the Floci Azure emulator
functions.remarks:
Reference the returned resource with Aspire's standard `WithReference` API to inject
its Service Bus connection string (e.g. for `AddAzureServiceBusClient`). The Artemis
sidecar is a separate container floci-az starts via Docker, so the emulator also needs
`WithDockerSocket`.
When ports are not specified, Docker assigns them as it starts the sidecar, and the integration
allocates the child's proxyless AMQP endpoints from the ports floci-az reports once it is ready.
The resource becomes `Running` at that point, so dependents can `WaitFor` it directly.
Requires floci-az 0.16.0 or later. This API is run-only; call it inside an
`ExecutionContext.IsRunMode` branch when publishing the AppHost.
functions.returns: A reference to the `IResourceBuilder`1` for further configuration.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The globally unique name of the Service Bus resource (default: `servicebus`). Pass a distinct name for each additional emulator.

fields.name: AmqpPort
fields.description: Host port for plain AMQP (default: assigned by Docker at startup).

fields.name: AmqpTlsPort
fields.description: Host port for AMQPS/TLS (default: assigned by Docker at startup).

handleTypes.name: FlociAzureServiceBusResource
handleTypes.description: Represents the Service Bus AMQP data plane exposed by a Floci Azure emulator resource.
handleTypes.remarks:
floci-az serves Service Bus AMQP from an Artemis sidecar container that publishes its ports
directly on the Docker host. The resource models those host ports as proxyless Aspire endpoints
which the integration allocates without proxying traffic to the parent container: configured
ports before startup, and ports assigned by Docker once floci-az is ready. Container consumers
require the runtime host-gateway mapping added by the Service Bus `WithReference` helper.
The parent is linked with a parent relationship annotation rather than
`IResourceWithParent`, because the resource's endpoints can only be resolved after
the parent has started. This resource is only supported in run mode.

capabilities.description: Gets the Service Bus connection string expression. `UseDevelopmentEmulator=true` makes the Azure SDKs use plain AMQP (no TLS), matching the official Service Bus emulator's connection-string shape.

capabilities.description: Gets the parent Floci Azure emulator resource.

`localhost` URL makes them treat `localhost` as the account name.

capabilities.description: Mounts the Docker socket into the Floci GCP container so that Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, and other container-backed services can launch sibling containers. Also sets `FLOCI_GCP_DOCKER_DOCKER_HOST` to `unix:///var/run/docker.sock` (the container-side path where the socket is always mounted) so Floci can connect to it.
capabilities.returns: A reference to the `IResourceBuilder`1` for further configuration.

fields.name: SocketPath
fields.description: Optional. Host path to the Docker socket (default: `/var/run/docker.sock`). Non-standard paths (e.g. Podman at `/run/user/1000/podman/podman.sock`) are bind-mounted to `/var/run/docker.sock` inside the container.

capabilities.name: WithFlociUI
capabilities.description: Adds a Floci UI web console container for the Floci GCP resource
capabilities.returns: A reference to the `IResourceBuilder`1` for further resource configuration.

fields.name: ConfigureContainer
fields.description: Configuration callback for the Floci UI container resource.

fields.name: ContainerName
fields.description: Optional. The name of the Floci UI container (default: `{floci-name}-ui`).

capabilities.name: WithHostPort
capabilities.description: Configures the host port that the Floci GCP resource is exposed on instead of using randomly assigned port.
capabilities.returns: The resource builder for Floci GCP.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port to bind on the host. If `null` is used random port will be assigned.

handleTypes.name: FlociUIContainerResource
